watchouts.issue: Tingle on compromised skin at high %
watchouts.what_to_do: High-percentage urea can tingle on cracked skin; lower levels are broadly gentle.

benefits.mechanism: Urea is a humectant component of the skin’s natural moisturizing factor, binding water within the stratum corneum.
benefits.what_it_means: Draws water into skin for lasting hydration and a softer feel.

benefits.mechanism: At higher concentrations urea loosens corneocyte bonds, gently helping shed rough surface build-up.
benefits.what_it_means: Softens and smooths rough, flaky or thickened areas with regular use.

evidence.summary: Humectant (NMF) and concentration-dependent smoothing are established cosmetic functions of urea; graded C (ingredient function).

overview: Urea is a dual-action natural-moisturizing-factor ingredient: it draws water into skin to hydrate, and at higher levels softens and smooths rough, flaky or thickened skin.

ingredient.what_it_is: A component of skin’s own natural moisturizing factor. At low levels it hydrates; at higher levels it also helps soften and smooth rough, flaky skin.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: Concentration decides its role: low levels (below ~10%) are purely hydrating and gentle; higher levels add a smoothing, softening action for rough or flaky areas.
